learning_outcomes.text: Defines the concepts of sets and number sets. Explains the concepts of identity, equation, and inequality.
Defines trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, and hyperbolic functions, piecewise, absolute value, floor, and sign functions.
Explains the concept of limit and calculates limits using the definition of limit. Proves the rules used for limit calculation.
Defines the concept of continuity in functions and knows the types of discontinuities.
Explains the concept of derivative and calculates derivatives using the definition of derivative. Proves differentiation rules using the definition of derivative.
Explains higher-order derivatives, the derivative of implicit functions, and defines tangent and normal lines.
Defines derivatives and differentials of functions given by parametric equations. Performs approximate calculations using differentials.
Solves extremum problems, knows the fundamental theorems of differential calculus.
Defines convex-concave concepts, asymptotes, and sketches the graph of a function.
Defines the concept of indefinite integral, applies substitution and integration by parts methods.
Calculates the integration of rational and irrational functions.
Calculates the integration of trigonometric functions.

syllabus_topics: Concept of Function, Elementary Functions (Domain-Range, Odd-Even Function, Increasing-Decreasing, Periodic, Implicit, Inverse).
Non-Elementary Functions (Absolute Value, Sign, Floor Function).
Limit of a Function, Right-Left Limit, Theorems Related to Limits (Squeeze Theorem,...).
Continuity of a Function, Related Theorems, Types of Discontinuities.
Derivative of a Function, Differentiation Rules (Derivative of Elementary Functions).
Higher-Order Derivatives, Derivative of Implicit Function, Tangent and Normal Lines.
Derivative of Parametric Function, Differential of a Function, Approximate Calculation Using Differentials.
Applications of Derivative (Indeterminate Forms, L'Hospital's Rule).
Extremum Problems, Fundamental Theorems of Differential Calculus (Lagrange, Rolle's Theorems).
Concavity and Inflection Points, Asymptotes, Graph Plotting.
Integration of Rational and Irrational Functions.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with a 50% contribution from in-semester studies and a 50% contribution from the final exam. The midterm exam contributes 100% to the in-semester studies.
